req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /openapi.json returns an HTTP 2xx response with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path returns 200 with correct content-type and openapi key; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — schema structure contains required top-level OpenAPI 3.x keys and exact app metadata values matching the FastAPI app configuration. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200, 405), exact field values ('openapi', 'info', 'paths', title='Task Manager API', version='1.0.0'), and checking that the openapi version string starts with '3.' to catch constant mutations.

tests.name: test_openapi_json_positive_returns_200_with_valid_payload
expected: Response body is valid JSON with 'openapi' key
trace: R-TASK-019: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_positive_returns_200_with_valid_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert body["openapi"].startswith("3.")
    assert "info" in body
    assert "paths" in body

test_openapi_json_positive_returns_200_with_valid_payload()

tests.name: test_openapi_json_boundary_schema_contains_exact_app_metadata
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialized with title='Task Manager API' and version='1.0.0'
actions: Inspect info.title, info.version, and openapi version prefix
trace: R-TASK-019: expected payload must reflect OpenAPI 3.x spec with correct app metadata
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_boundary_schema_contains_exact_app_metadata():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["openapi"].startswith("3.")
    assert body["info"]["title"] == "Task Manager API"
    assert body["info"]["version"] == "1.0.0"
    paths = body["paths"]
    assert "/tasks/" in paths
    assert "/tasks/{task_id}" in paths
    assert "/" in paths

test_openapi_json_boundary_schema_contains_exact_app_metadata()

trace: R-TASK-019: OpenAPI schema must accurately reflect all registered endpoints
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_boundary_tasks_path_has_get_and_post_operations():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    tasks_path = body["paths"]["/tasks/"]
    assert "get" in tasks_path
    assert "post" in tasks_path
    task_id_path = body["paths"]["/tasks/{task_id}"]
    assert "get" in task_id_path
    assert "put" in task_id_path
    assert "delete" in task_id_path

test_openapi_json_boundary_tasks_path_has_get_and_post_operations()

tests.name: test_openapi_json_positive_response_is_idempotent
expected: Both response bodies are identical JSON objects
trace: R-TASK-019: deterministic — repeated calls must return same schema
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_positive_response_is_idempotent():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get("/openapi.json")
    r2 = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r1.json() == r2.json()

test_openapi_json_positive_response_is_idempotent()
